candidate_semantics: network = the committee mix's network table as a weighted mean of seed ensembles; network_share = its weight in the committee mix (committee share 1 - network_share). ens_ctx 0.5 + ens_ctx_e24 0.5 is the 32-seed mean. LIRF blends, residual stage, outer weight 0.7 and floor stay v27's (= v26's).

control.official: v27 not yet uploaded at declaration time; if v27 is not shipped, the ship decision for this round's selection returns to the user
control.recipe: v27 = configs/adsb_ctx_v1.json candidate ctx_b100_s65 (v26's committee, LIRF blends, residual stage, outer weight 0.7 and floor; committee mix network table ens_ctx, share 0.65)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

execution.compute_budget: CPU only (memory: Azure CPU essentially free, GPU only where necessary)
execution.network_hosts: Azure arcw0-arcw7, two lanes per worker (seeds 117-124 lane A on arcw0-7, 125-132 lane B), 8 threads per lane, tools/ctx_chain.sh configs/adsb_ctx_network_v2.json ctx_e24 <seed> runs/adsb_ctx seasonal forward refit refit12 (launcher tools/ctx_launch_dev2.sh)
execution.scorer: tools/run_adsb_ctx_dev2.py; its --smoke (ens_ctx_e24 replaced by ens_ctx) must reproduce the control on all four months before --score

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

ens_ctx.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
ens_ctx.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh
ens_ctx.status: fitted and scored under adsb_ctx_v1 (its ensemble directory and December leaves unchanged)

ens_ctx_e24.ensemble: ens_ctx_e24 = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e24.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

gpu_design.note: g_e24 (24 epochs) the only qualifying variant: +0.154 points of recipe proxy over g_ctx at 2 seeds, single runs worse standalone, 2-seed mean better (thin)

prior_evidence.seed_scaling: round-1 design: recipe proxy at b = 1 from 1 to 6 seeds -0.54, -0.93, -1.08, -1.10, -1.17, -1.19%, still rising

v1_selection.note: every v1 candidate eligible; the mean gain rose monotonically with the context network's weight (b 0.5/0.75/1.0: -0.46/-0.66/-0.83%) and share (0.5 -> 0.65: -0.83 -> -1.02%); 0.65 was the grid's largest share

purpose: Round A after adsb_ctx_v1 (v27 = ctx_b100_s65): does a 24-epoch budget, a 32-seed context pool or a larger network share improve the v27 recipe? Declared before any fit of the 24-epoch seeds.
selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v27. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
ship: If a candidate is selected: the coverage-regime ship check (the gate of configs/adsb_ctx_regime_check_v1.json, both thinned months) is re-run for the selected candidate before any export; ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; the shipped v27 ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components with the control's tables and must reproduce the uploaded v27 exactly; then the selected pool and share are applied, exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently (every saved context network reloaded and re-predicted on its token and feature inputs), audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval.
